summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Broadband Solutions 24x7 completed. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests PASSED (health, OTP request/verify with role-based seed accounts, plans listing, recharge->invoice->subscription flow with role isolation, complaints CRUD with subscriber/team/admin permission checks, team management with super_admin-only admin creation, admin metrics, subscribers list, Hindi Claude-Haiku chat + history). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): Login screen renders with 'Demo Accounts' hint, phone->OTP->role-based navigation works for subscriber (9999999996) and admin (9999999998). Subscriber home displays ACTIVE PLAN card correctly, Recharge tab lists all 4 seeded plans, 'Pay via UPI' modal accepts UPI ID and after Confirm redirects to /invoice/{id} showing PAID invoice detail. Complaints tab shows list with functioning FAB. AI Chat screen sends Hindi message and receives Hindi reply from Claude Haiku 4.5 (via emergentintegrations). Admin overview renders metric cards (Subscribers, Team, Active Plans, Open Tickets, Total Revenue) with 4 bottom tabs (Overview, Users, Team, Tickets). Deprecation warnings noted in console (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) but non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /chat while unauthenticated triggers an Uncaught 'Missing token' red-screen error because useEffect immediately calls api.chatHistory() with no auth guard/redirect. Users reaching /chat via Home tile after login are fine, but deep-linking or refreshing on /chat without token crashes.
Send button uses testID 'send-chat' - matches expected pattern but note it is not 'chat-send-btn' (informational; test used the correct testID)

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should migrate before RN 0.80+

action_items: Optional: Add auth-gate in /app/frontend/app/chat.tsx (redirect to '/' if no token) or wrap the initial chatHistory() call in try/catch that suppresses 401 and starts fresh chat, to prevent red-screen when unauthenticated users deep-link to /chat.
Optional cleanup: Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' from props into style to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~530 lines) - acceptable but nearing threshold; consider splitting routes into modules if it grows.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded in all queries via projection {'_id': 0} and the clean() helper - good.
JWT auth is stateless with role checks via require_role dependency - clean pattern.
Chat endpoint gracefully falls back to Hindi error string if emergentintegrations fails - good defensive coding.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; minor chat auth-guard nit)

seed_data_creation: Test data (TEST_ prefixed complaints, team members, users) was created via backend_test.py. Seeded users (super_admin, admin, team, subscriber) already existed via server.py seed(). One recharge invoice for subscriber 9999999996 (Basic 50, ₹499) created during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env: https://localnet-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. All seeded test phones use OTP 123456. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run via 'pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v'. Frontend Expo web serves at same base URL. Chat AI uses claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env - response time ~5-10s. Correct testIDs: phone-input, request-otp-btn, otp-input, name-input, verify-otp-btn, chat-input, send-chat, chat-back, clear-chat, back-btn.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no blocking bugs. Minor: chat screen calls api.chatHistory() in useEffect without auth-guard; if token is absent (deep link / stale session), the throw new Error('Missing token') from src/api.ts:46 surfaces as an uncaught error in Expo dev overlay. Mitigation: wrap in try/catch or check loadAuth() first and router.replace('/') if no token.
